**Finding submitted — GOVLAW: deviation (venue gap).**

- **What the document says:** § 14.3 selects New York substantive law (preferred law element already met), but the Agreement contains no forum clause at all. Full-document searches for venue/jurisdiction/courts/dispute/arbitration surfaced only incidental "court of competent jurisdiction" references in § 8.1, § 8.2 and § 14.5; §§ 14.4 (jury waiver) and 14.14 (two-year actions period) are related but do not designate a forum.
- **Why it fails:** with no exclusive court venue, neither the preferred nor the fallback forum element is met, leaving venue open to Vendor-favourable forum shopping. No arbitration provision exists, so this is not walk-away territory.
- **Cure (preferred level, one insertion):** a single sentence after p0171 giving the state and federal courts in New York County exclusive jurisdiction, with the customary temporary injunctive-relief carve-out; the New York law sentence is preserved verbatim.
